shortDescription: Sends a message over a socket and expects a specific response

options.name: expected_response
options.description: The response expected from the target upon sending the message.

options.name: host
options.description: The target host IP or hostname where the message will be sent.

options.name: message
options.description: The message to be sent to the target host and port.

options.name: port
options.description: The target port on the host to which the message will be sent.

options.name: timeout_seconds
options.description: The timeout in seconds for waiting for the expected response.
